actions.halfwayHint: The last approval did not finish. Approve again to continue; no duplicate is created.

approveDialog.title: Approve request
approveDialog.description: Choose the project, type and the agent who takes it. The request is posted word for word as the board would, then the agent starts.
approveDialog.author: Sent by

approveDialog.noAssistant: The project has no Assistant; choose an agent.

errors.crew_contribution_not_materialized: The posted record was not found yet. Click Approve again.
errors.crew_contribution_decided: This item is already settled (approved or rejected).
errors.crew_contribution_locked: Another owner is approving this item. Try again in a few minutes (the lock lasts at most 10 minutes).
errors.crew_contribution_not_approving: This item is no longer being approved. Its latest status has been reloaded.
errors.crew_contribution_already_approved: This item is already approved, so it can no longer be rejected.
errors.crew_contribution_invalid: The contribution content is invalid (for example, it contains control characters or the title is too long).
errors.crew_contribution_invalid_target: The project or target request is no longer valid (archived, deleted or hidden).
errors.crew_contribution_forbidden: You are not allowed to approve this item.
errors.crew_contributions_unavailable: Contributions are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.crew_contribution_store_failed: The server could not save the contribution. Try again later.
errors.alreadyRejected: This item was already rejected, so it can no longer be approved.

issuesGroup.empty: No request is waiting for approval
